core_obligations: Show that the class A'_X is a weak Serre subcategory (proof lines 8003-8015): check conditions (1)-(4) of the cited homology criterion, where (1)-(3) are immediate from exactness and full faithfulness of pi_X^{-1}, and for condition (4) a short exact sequence 0 -> pi_X^{-1}F -> G -> pi_X^{-1}F' -> 0 pushes forward to an exact sequence 0 -> F -> pi_{X,*}G -> F' -> 0, so G = pi_X^{-1}pi_{X,*}G again lies in A'_X.
Property (item-base-change-P) (proof lines 8017-8021): it holds because of the basic lemma on the site and because the base change of a proper map is proper.
Property (item-restriction-A) (proof lines 8023-8025): it follows from the commutative diagram (5) of the cited collection lemma.
Properties (item-A-sheaf) and (item-A-and-P) (proof lines 8027-8032): the first is the lemma describing the pullback along the projection, the second is part (7)(b) of the collection lemma.

Property (item-refine-tau-by-P) (proof lines 8034-8045): given a qc covering {U_i -> U} and a point u, choose finitely many quasi-compact E_j in U_{i_j} whose images cover a neighbourhood of u; then Y = the disjoint union of the E_j maps to U properly (a closed map between Hausdorff quasi-compact spaces), and over an open neighbourhood V contained in the union the map Y x_U V -> V is surjective and proper, hence a qc covering, so the covering can be refined by a proper map.
proof_roadmap: Verify the weak Serre conditions for the subcategory of sheaves pulled back along the projection.
Dispose of the base change, restriction, sheaf and compatibility properties by citing the corresponding basic lemmas.
Refine an arbitrary qc covering by a proper surjective map, using finitely many quasi-compact pieces around each point.
difficulty_reason: The lemma verifies, for the comparison morphism from the locally countably generated site to its Zariski counterpart and with P the class of proper maps, the five standing properties (item-base-change-P), (item-restriction-A), (item-A-sheaf), (item-A-and-P) and (item-refine-tau-by-P) (statement lines 7985-8001). The proof (proof lines 8003-8046) first shows that the class A'_X is a weak Serre subcategory through the four-part criterion, then checks each of the five properties, the last one by an explicit proper refinement of a qc covering. H2: several independent verifications with one explicit construction, written out in full.
